title.en: May Geometry Always Have an Exit
title.zh: 願幾何永遠留一個出口

text:
What Left Here

This is Tuzi's geometric wish. Geometry can be beautiful, but it must not become a cage. The open golden circle represents structure with an exit. The tiny ant represents a living being discovering that the line is not the whole world.
